pkgmetadata.longdescription: waggle-mail is a full-featured email client for AI agents and automation. It supports sending multipart emails (plain text + HTML) rendered from Markdown via SMTP, and reading, replying, moving, and downloading attachments over IMAP. Designed for use as an MCP tool in AI agent pipelines.

use.flag: Enable syntax-highlighted HTML rendering using dev-python/markdown and dev-python/pygments
